failure_modes: There is no way in. Nothing places a wreck in the world and nothing yields an Ancient Component, so a player never finds a machine: the ladder starts only if they build a 'wreck' from the menu for 30 steel, and it stops at Kludged. root.text: Wrecked Machines changes specified machines that install like furniture, such as those of Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory, into advanced, ancient machines. A colony can no longer simply research and build one. A colony must find one and bring it to a safe place. Colonists study the machine, and the study opens its research. Then they repair the machine slowly, through levels of function. A Wrecked machine does not work. A Kludged machine works at a minimum. A Refurbished machine has full function, but is slower than the original. The Original is a fourth level, there only for comparison: no research and no repair reaches it. Each repair needs study of the machine, time at a research bench and considerable resources. The last repair, to Refurbished, also needs a rare Ancient Component. The idea can be applied to any game tree. This first version supports only Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory in this way, and some versions of vanilla expanded items such as archotech power supplies and psychic emitters.
root.words: The mod changes specified furniture-installable machines such as Vanilla Factory Enhanced into advanced, ancient machines that can no longer simply be researched and built like normal. Instead, they must be found and retrieved to a safe location, studied to enable research, and then slowly repaired through several levels of functionality: wrecked (nonfunctional), Kludged (minimal), Refurbished (full functionality but slower than original), Original (no longer attainable through research or repair, used only for comparison). Each repair requires machine study, research bench time, and considerable resources. The final refurbishment requires a rare ancient component. While the concept may be applied to any game tree, the mod's initial version will only support Vanilla Factory Enhanced in this fashion.
